description: This file defines the RelayCommand class, which implements the ICommand interface for command binding in a WPF MVVM application.

classes.name: RelayCommand
classes.description: A command implementation that allows binding actions and conditions to UI elements in MVVM pattern.

methods.name: RelayCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with execute and canExecute delegates.

methods.name: CanExecute
methods.description: Determines whether the command can execute with the given parameter.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the command action with the provided parameter.

methods.name: RaiseCanExecuteChanged
methods.description: Raises the CanExecuteChanged event to notify the UI to reevaluate command executability.
